title: An Optimal 14-Symbol Hybrid Basis for BCH-Algebras
summary: We present an optimally minimal two-axiom basis for BCH-algebras. The standard presentation of a BCH-algebra relies on three axioms: two equations and one quasi-identity. Using automated theorem proving, we prove that the two standard equations can be entirely replaced by a 14-symbol equation, ((xy)z)((x(z0))y) = 0, while retaining the standard quasi-identity. We then provide a rigorous proof of strict minimality for this new equational companion.
